view.en: Top-down 2D sealed boss room shown on one screen, possibly with rocks inside. You control a bald child, the Tear Kid, with twin-stick controls: one set of keys moves, another set shoots tears in four directions. Your hearts (half-heart steps) are at the top left and the boss's health bar is at the top

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose when all your hearts are gone; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate. A versus banner shows at the start and the boss only starts acting after about 1.3 seconds

keys.en: place a bomb: you start with only 1; it deals big damage but costs you a whole heart if it hits you

notes.en: Moving and shooting are independent: you can retreat left while shooting right. When several shoot keys are held only the most recent direction counts, so hold one at a time
Tears only go in four directions with no aiming; to hit the boss, line yourself up with its row or column, and tears have limited range
After a hit you are invulnerable for a while (about 1 second for half a heart, about 2 seconds for a full heart) and are pushed away; you cannot be hurt during it

Most contact and small shots cost half a heart; large tears and your own bomb cost a full heart; at high difficulty half-heart hits also become full hearts. At zero health you fall and lose after about a second
You carry a fixed set of passive upgrades (fire rate, damage, range, special tears such as multi-shot, piercing, homing, bouncing) that apply automatically; there is no active item to use
The bomb is a one-off burst of heavy damage; save it for when the boss is close, and step away yourself

move.en: eight-direction movement with WASD held for the whole 200 ms

fire.en: shoot tears in one of four directions, held for the whole 200 ms

summary.en: A huge blob in an open room that hops at you, spits shot spreads and leaps to crash down on you. It is dangerous up close, so keep your distance and circle while shooting

tell.en: It crouches briefly, then hops, 1 to 3 times in a row

effect.en: It lands toward where you were at takeoff; it is harmless in the air, and its body costs half a heart on contact after landing

counter.en: Sidestep the landing spot and shoot it during its short pause after landing

tell.en: Its cheeks puff up, then about half a second later it fires a fan of shots at once

effect.en: A scattered fan aimed toward you with varied speeds and ranges; most are small shots costing half a heart, a few are big tears costing a full heart

counter.en: While it puffs, move sideways into a gap of the fan, or back off so the shots spread out

tell.en: It crouches deep and leaps up off the screen; a shadow follows you on the ground, then locks as a red dashed circle

effect.en: Anything inside the circle is hurt when it lands, then it sprays a ring of shots outward

counter.en: Run out of the circle once it locks, then dodge the ring and shoot after landing

summary.en: A long worm made of many segments that crawls along the grid in right-angle turns, leaving dung piles behind. Every segment can be shot, and cutting it splits it in two

tell.en: The head advances along the grid centre lines and the body segments follow its path

effect.en: Any segment touching you costs half a heart; it has no ranged attack

counter.en: Stand in a row or column it will not turn into, and shoot approaching segments from the side

tell.en: At a grid centre the head may suddenly turn toward your row or column

effect.en: Changes its route and heads straight at you

counter.en: Do not stay on one row or column for long; keep moving and leave an escape route

tell.en: A dung pile appears on the cell behind its tail

effect.en: Piles block the way; the worm smashes one and turns when it hits it, and piles also block your movement and tears

counter.en: Use piles to force turns, and do not trap yourself between a pile and a wall

tell.en: After you kill a middle segment, the worm breaks into two that crawl on separately

effect.en: If both parts are long enough they become two separate worms; if the head dies the next segment becomes the new head

counter.en: Shoot the nearest segments first and watch for two heads chasing you at once

phases.en: At higher difficulty the worm is longer, faster and turns toward you more often

summary.en: A big bug body drifting diagonally and bouncing off walls, constantly releasing flies. Flies orbit it to block shots or chase you; you must clear all flies and the body

tell.en: The body moves slowly on a diagonal and bounces off walls; tears nudge it along their direction

effect.en: Body contact costs half a heart

counter.en: Read its diagonal and shoot from a line not covered by flies

tell.en: Its body swells for about 0.4 seconds, then three flies appear circling it

effect.en: Orbiting flies block tears aimed at the body; they are sturdy, and a fly costs half a heart on touching you and then dies

counter.en: Shoot down some orbiters before the body, and do not let them pile up to four or five

tell.en: The same swelling tell, then a larger fly appears and chases you

effect.en: The big fly chases you and costs half a heart on contact

counter.en: Retreat while shooting it down

tell.en: When five or six orbit it, it swells and they all break away at once

effect.en: All orbiting flies turn into chasers at the same time

counter.en: Break up the orbiters beforehand, or keep distance and shoot them down piece by piece

phases.en: When the body dies, remaining orbiters turn into chasers; you only win after every fly is dead

summary.en: A large and a small body joined by a cord: the big one chases and charges, the small one trails behind and shoots at you. Four symmetric rocks serve as cover

tell.en: The big one walks slowly toward you

effect.en: Touching its body at the feet costs half a heart

counter.en: Circle around the rocks and shoot from a distance

tell.en: After chasing for a while it suddenly speeds up and rushes at you, turning only slowly

effect.en: A high-speed hit costs half a heart; after hitting a rock or finishing it stops to pant for a moment

counter.en: Sidestep or hide behind a rock when the charge starts, and pour damage in while it pants

tell.en: The small one pauses to charge for about 0.3 seconds; it does not shoot when a rock blocks the line

effect.en: Fires one shot at you, costing half a heart

counter.en: Move during the charge and use rocks for cover

tell.en: After the big one dies, the small one breaks free and accelerates at you with heavy inertia, overshooting

effect.en: Contact costs half a heart; being hit by tears actually speeds it up

counter.en: Circle it, and shoot from the side or behind after it overshoots

phases.en: Killing the big one first frees the small one to rush; killing the small one first leaves the big one unchanged

summary.en: A horse and rider that charge along horizontal lanes and summon shot-spitting flies. At low health only a head remains and creeps toward you. Contact costs a full heart in both phases

tell.en: When you stand in the red horizontal lane at its level it rears for about half a second, then dashes across the screen and returns from the other side

effect.en: Hitting you costs a full heart, and it also crushes the flies

counter.en: Avoid staying in its lane; move up or down out of the red lane when it rears

tell.en: It stops for a summoning pose of about half a second and a fly appears beside it

effect.en: The fly drifts slowly toward you and, at close range, charges and spits one shot costing half a heart; it does no contact damage and at most 2 exist

counter.en: Shoot the flies first, or lure the rider into charging through them

tell.en: When the flies are at the limit it moves to your row and backs to the far end

effect.en: Sets up the next lane charge

counter.en: Change rows as soon as you see it line up

tell.en: In the second phase only the head creeps closer, stops for about 0.4 seconds, then fires

effect.en: Fires a three-shot fan toward you

counter.en: Step sideways when it stops, and shoot it between volleys

phases.en: At low health the horse and body burst apart, leaving only a head that approaches and fires triple shots; no more lane charges

summary.en: A big head always flies on 45-degree diagonals and bounces off walls. Each time it dies it splits into two smaller, faster heads, for three generations, so more and more heads fill the room

tell.en: The head flies diagonally and bounces off walls, sometimes bouncing toward you

effect.en: Contact costs half a heart; no ranged attack

counter.en: Predict the diagonal path and shoot from outside it

tell.en: Every second or two its diagonal suddenly turns toward you at the same speed

effect.en: A player standing still is easily hit

counter.en: Do not stand in doorways or corners; keep moving and keep space around you

tell.en: When a head dies it becomes two smaller heads that fly apart

effect.en: The smaller they are, the faster and harder to hit

counter.en: Break the big head from far away so you have time to react to the small ones

phases.en: Three splits in total: big head into two medium, each into two small, each into two tiny ones; you win only when all are gone
